headings.text: How to Give a Short English Presentation

paragraphs: Structure a 2-minute talk: opening, body, close. With phrases that keep the audience with you.
A short presentation follows a fixed shape.
"Good morning everyone. Today I will talk about improving English at home."
"To sum up, small daily steps bring big change. Thank you. Any questions?"
Speak slower than normal. Pause after key points. Eye contact with different people.
Record your 2-minute talk on SpeakNow. Watch filler words and speed. Do it 3 times.
Presentations are just introductions with more points. You already have the skill.
Free browser-based English speaking practice. No downloads, no sign-ups, no data leaving your computer.
